title: [nightly/design] Social: your own code to copy, and a count of requests to answer
summary: Social shows your own friend code with a Copy button next to Add a friend, so you don't have to dig through Settings when someone asks for it at the course, and the Inbox button shows how many friend requests are waiting for your answer.
